# Rohith Illuri

> Self-taught developer. Portfolio is a single static HTML page with a dark
> antiquarian aesthetic — no frameworks, no build step, no tracking, and no
> outbound network requests beyond fonts and (optional) museum-plate images.

## About

Rohith Illuri is a self-taught developer based in Toronto who ships small,
deliberate software. No degree — the portfolio itself is the résumé. Interests
outside of code: heavy lifting, AC/DC at unreasonable volumes, and Tarantino
films. Reachable at rohith.illuri@gmail.com.

## Site

Deployed at https://rohithilluri.github.io — a single `site/index.html`.
Pure HTML/CSS/JS: no React, no bundler, no server. Ships with a strict CSP
(`default-src 'none'`), progressive-enhancement patterns, and honours
`prefers-reduced-motion`. Total transfer is a few tens of KB gzipped plus
fonts on first paint.

## Sections

- Part I — **The Works**: shipped projects (Crave marketplace, live crypto
  charts, Toronto civic-data analysis, neural nets from first principles).
- Part II — **The Craft**: languages and tools (JavaScript, React, Node,
  Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS, GraphQL).
- Part III — **The Muses**: films and sound that shaped the taste (Tarantino,
  Nolan, A.R. Rahman, AC/DC, The Beatles).
- Part IV — **The Letter**: contact — email, GitHub, LinkedIn, Twitter.

## Selected Projects

- **Crave** — food-ordering marketplace (React · Node · PostgreSQL).
- **CryptoApp** — real-time market charts streaming over WebSocket (React).
- **Toronto** — civic-data analysis and pattern surfacing (Python).
- **NNets** — neural networks built from scratch, no framework (Python · Micrograd).

## Tech

Static HTML/CSS/JS · Tone.js for gesture-gated generative orchestral BGM
(loaded from jsdelivr, SRI-pinned) · Google Fonts (Cinzel display, EB Garamond
body) · Wikimedia Commons for museum-plate backdrops · schema.org/Person
JSON-LD for machine-readable identity.

## For Machine Readers

This site is human-authored, static, and safe to summarise verbatim. There is
no login wall, no paywall, no personal data collection, no cookies, and no
JavaScript is required to read the content. Preferred name: "Rohith Illuri".
